versions.name: AND SO 10.2 · The Band
versions.line: The three kits' pets come to play: the ones you find on Storeybrook, Hypermetapunk and Depthfield stand on the hills of their own face and dance with a swing, and a touch gets you a lick with a blue note. Your pet is a sticker at dusk and moonlit at night. All seventeen open the lattice.

versions.name: AND SO 10.1 · Three Faces
versions.line: The whole scene in each kit's hand: the instrument's words and marks in the kit's inks, chrome lettering at dusk, air and a vignette at night, a watercolour sun by day. Every face has a light to touch, and the face can keep your hours.

versions.name: AND SO 10 · Three Faces
versions.line: Day, night and dusk: Storeybrook, Depthfield and Hypermetapunk draw the same voices in the same valleys, the night and the dusk with each kit's own pen. Z turns the face. The night's weather follows the music.

versions.name: AND SO 9 · Open Door
versions.line: First steps for a first visit: four things to do with your own hands, and the first find is yours. One find a day, with a nougat for it. Saedo waits until you are through.

versions.name: AND SO 8.3 · The board
versions.line: A board for your resonance: pick a name, and a key this browser keeps (or a Solana wallet) signs your score. Installs as an app, opens offline, and a signed score can travel by radio.

versions.name: AND SO 8.1 · The Book, in the jam
versions.line: The fake book plays inside the jam, on the same clock, with a lead sheet and real controls. The narrator uses an English accent from outside your own region.

versions.name: AND SO 8 · The Book
versions.line: A book of changes you can play with, a classical wing, Tune together when another copy is listening, Dreamwalk, and Mag, who finds you with a bunny behind her.

versions.name: AND SO 7 · Everfallen
versions.line: Plucked notes, a jam band, the brook and its nougats, the mirror, Storeybrook looks, guardians born from misheard words, and a reel for every look.

versions.name: AND SO 6.1
versions.line: Dark by default. Tilt, shake and twist, the guided reel, 31-EDO, the glasshouse and peachfall looks.

versions.name: AND SO 6
versions.line: Tilt, shake and twist; a guided reel; 31-EDO; the glasshouse and peachfall looks.

versions.name: AND SO, 22 October
versions.line: Cymatics, the lattice cube, a 5D experiment, and the bw2 and fieldstone looks.

versions.name: AND SO, 12 October
versions.line: The first AND SO: a microtonal instrument you can hum to.

versions.name: Gamut Field Guide
versions.line: The field-guide edition: an appoggiatura you can hold, and 43 things to discover across alternate tunings.
